units.source_text: 匂亲王看了浮舟回答他的诗，觉得诗中口气与往常不同，似乎含有别种意思，

en.t: Prince Niou read the poem Ukifune had sent in reply to his, and felt that its tone was unlike her usual one, as though it carried some other meaning,

units.source_text: 想道：“她到底打算怎样呢？

en.t: and thought, "What can she be intending after all?

units.source_text: 她原是有心爱我的。

en.t: She did once have feelings for me.

units.source_text: 但只恐我变心，深怀疑虑，所以逃往别处去躲藏了吧？”

en.t: Perhaps she only feared that my heart had changed, and in deep suspicion fled somewhere else to hide?"

units.source_text: 他很不放心，便派一个使者去察探。

en.t: He was deeply uneasy, and so sent a messenger to make inquiries.

units.source_text: 使者到了山庄，只见满屋子的人都在号哭，信也无法送上。

en.t: When the messenger reached the villa, he found everyone in the house wailing, and he could not even deliver the letter.

units.source_text: 他向一个女仆探问情由，女仆答道：“小姐昨夜忽然去世，大家正在惊慌失措呢。

en.t: He asked a maid what had happened, and she replied, "The young lady suddenly passed away last night, and everyone is in complete confusion.

units.source_text: 能做主的人偏偏又不在这里，我们一群底下人只得东靠西倚，弄得束手无策了。”

en.t: The very people who could take charge are not here, so we servants can only turn this way and that, helpless and at a loss."

units.source_text: 这使者并不深悉内情，故亦不详细探问，就回京去了。

en.t: The messenger did not know the inner circumstances well, so he did not question her in detail and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 他把所见情状报告了匂亲王。

en.t: He reported what he had seen to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王如在梦中，十分惊诧。

en.t: Prince Niou felt as if he were in a dream, and was utterly astonished.

units.source_text: 他想：“我并未听说她患重病。

en.t: He thought, "I had not heard that she was seriously ill.

units.source_text: 只知道她近来常常闷闷不乐。

en.t: I only knew that lately she was often gloomy and unhappy.

units.source_text: 然而昨天的回信中看不出这方面的迹象，笔致反而比往常更加秀美呢。”

en.t: Yet in yesterday's reply there was no sign of anything like that; her handwriting was, if anything, even more graceful than usual."

units.source_text: 他疑团莫释，便召唤时方，对他说道：“你去察看一下，问明确实情由。”

en.t: Unable to dispel his doubts, he summoned Tokikata and said to him, "Go and look into it, and find out the true facts clearly."

units.source_text: 时方答道：“恐怕薰大将已经听到什么风声，所以严厉斥责守夜人，说他们怠职。

en.t: Tokikata answered, "I fear that General Kaoru has already heard some rumor, for he has harshly reprimanded the night guards, saying they neglected their duty.

units.source_text: 近来仆役们出入都要拦阻，仔细盘问。

en.t: Recently even the servants have been stopped whenever they go in or out and questioned closely.

units.source_text: 我时方倘无适当借口，贸然赴宇治山庄，被大将得知了，深恐他要怀疑呢。

en.t: If I, Tokikata, went rashly to the Uji villa without a proper excuse and the general learned of it, I greatly fear he would become suspicious.

units.source_text: 况且那边突然死了一个人，定然喧哗扰攘，出入的人很多。”

en.t: Besides, since someone has suddenly died there, the place is sure to be in an uproar, with many people coming and going."

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“你的话也不错，然而总不能听其自然，置之不理呀。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "What you say is reasonable, but I cannot simply leave things to take their course and do nothing.

units.source_text: 你还得想个适当办法，去找那知情的侍从，问明究竟是怎么一回事。

en.t: You must still think of some suitable way to find the attendant who knows the situation and ask clearly what really happened.

units.source_text: 刚才这仆人所报告的恐有错误。”

en.t: There may be some mistake in what that servant just reported."

units.source_text: 时方看见主人可怜，觉得不好意思违命，便在傍晚时分动身前往。

en.t: Seeing how pitiable his master was, Tokikata felt unable to disobey, and set out toward evening.
